name: Bromo Marathon 2026
short_description: Bromo Marathon 2026 is a full-marathon race held on September 6, 2026, at Plataran Bromo in Tosari, East Java, Indonesia.
ai_summary: Bromo Marathon 2026 is a full-marathon event scheduled for September 6, 2026, at Plataran Bromo in Tosari, East Java, Indonesia. Runners can choose from five distances: 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, 5km, and 2.5km, catering to a range of experience levels. Registration for the event has not yet been announced.
pros: Multiple distance options (42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, 5km, 2.5km) suit a wide range of runners
Scenic venue at Plataran Bromo in East Java
Clear event date set for September 6, 2026
cons: Registration status is not yet announced, so sign-up details are unavailable

research_highlights: The full marathon starts at 1,840m altitude and includes a demanding climb to around 2,469–2,491m near the 30km mark, making the middle section a significant uphill test.
The 21K half marathon has a reported elevation gain of 977 meters, described by organisers as one of Southeast Asia's most challenging half marathons.
Terrain is mixed: volcanic sand, rocky paths, forest trail, and paved roads, so trail running shoes are strongly recommended and sandals/barefoot running are banned.
Cut-off times are 10 hours for the 42K, 7 hours for the 21K, 4 hours for the 10K, and 3 hours for the 5K.
BIB collection and mandatory race briefing (for 42K/21K) happen the day before race day (Saturday) at Plataran Bromo — no same-day race packet pickup is permitted.
research_watchouts: Guest house and accommodation capacity in Tosari is limited during race weekend; the 2024 edition closed registration early partly due to lodging shortages, with some runners housed as far as Probolinggo.
Parking near the start/finish is limited and fills up quickly, so organisers strongly recommend using the official shuttle instead of driving.

Mandatory gear (hydration pack, rain jacket, emergency blanket, whistle, headlamp for 42K, etc.) is checked at BIB collection and may be spot-checked on course, with missing gear resulting in disqualification.
Road running shoes may lack sufficient grip on the volcanic sand and rocky sections of the course.

faqs.question: When is the Bromo Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Bromo Marathon 2026 is scheduled to take place on September 6, 2026. This date applies to the full event, which includes the primary marathon distance of 42.195km as well as several shorter distance options held at the same venue in East Java, Indonesia.

faqs.question: Where is the Bromo Marathon 2026 held?
faqs.answer: The race takes place at Plataran Bromo, located in Tosari, East Java, Indonesia. This venue serves as the central location for all five distance categories offered during the event, making it the starting point for runners participating in the 2026 edition.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Bromo Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The event offers five distance options: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, plus 10km, 5km, and 2.5km races. The 42.195km full marathon is the primary distance, allowing participants to choose a distance that matches their fitness and experience.

faqs.question: Is registration open for the Bromo Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: As of now, the registration status for the Bromo Marathon 2026 is listed as 'Not Yet Announced.' This means specific sign-up dates, fees, and procedures have not been released yet, so prospective participants should check back later for updates on how to register.
